import QleisliKernel.QftGraph
import QleisliKernel.ControlledPowers
import QleisliKernel.Uniform

/-! Internal complete QPE plan binding. No external registry is enabled here.
Copyright 2026 Masahiko G. Yamada. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 -/

namespace QleisliKernel.Qpe

inductive ClassicalType where
  | bit | bits (width : Nat)
  deriving BEq, DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Orientation where
  | forward | inverse
  deriving BEq, DecidableEq, Repr

inductive TargetExit where
  | retain | measure | discard
  deriving BEq, DecidableEq, Repr

structure Header where
  inputs : Layout.Interface
  outputs : Layout.Interface
  classicalInputs : List ClassicalType
  classicalOutputs : List ClassicalType
  effect : QftGraph.Effect
  targetOwner : Nat
  precisionOwner : Nat
  targetAxes : List Nat
  precisionAxes : List Nat
  orientation : Orientation
  measurementAxes : List Nat
  targetExit : TargetExit
  deriving BEq, DecidableEq, Repr

def header (targetWidth precision : Nat) : Header :=
  let precisionAxes := (List.range precision).map (targetWidth + ·)
  ⟨QftGraph.interface targetWidth, QftGraph.interface targetWidth, [], [.bits precision],
    .observe, 0, 1, List.range targetWidth, precisionAxes, .inverse, precisionAxes, .retain⟩

structure Plan where
  boundary : Header
  precisionInitial : List Bool
  preparation : List Interference.Gate
  powers : List ControlledPowers.Stage
  fourier : List QftGraph.Definition
  fourierEntry : Nat
  deriving Repr

/-- Independently requested dimensions/provider; no unitary/access flag is trusted.
The full external importer must supply checked provider evidence separately. -/
def check (targetWidth precision provider : Nat) (plan : Plan) : Option QftGraph.Receipt :=
  if !(1 ≤ targetWidth && targetWidth ≤ 8 && 1 ≤ precision && precision ≤ 8 &&
      targetWidth + precision ≤ 16) then none
  else if plan.boundary ≠ header targetWidth precision then none
  else if plan.precisionInitial ≠ List.replicate precision false then none
  else if plan.preparation ≠ Uniform.word precision then none
  else if !ControlledPowers.check precision provider plan.powers then none
  else QftGraph.check plan.fourier plan.fourierEntry precision

theorem check_conditions (targetWidth precision provider : Nat) (plan : Plan)
    (receipt : QftGraph.Receipt)
    (accepted : check targetWidth precision provider plan = some receipt) :
    (1 ≤ targetWidth ∧ targetWidth ≤ 8 ∧ 1 ≤ precision ∧ precision ≤ 8 ∧
      targetWidth + precision ≤ 16) ∧
    plan.boundary = header targetWidth precision ∧
    plan.precisionInitial = List.replicate precision false ∧
    plan.preparation = Uniform.word precision ∧
    ControlledPowers.check precision provider plan.powers = true ∧
    QftGraph.check plan.fourier plan.fourierEntry precision = some receipt := by
  unfold check at accepted
  split at accepted
  next impossible => contradiction
  next bounded =>
    split at accepted
    next invalid => contradiction
    next signature =>
      split at accepted
      next invalid => contradiction
      next zero =>
        split at accepted
        next invalid => contradiction
        next uniform =>
          split at accepted
          next invalid => contradiction
          next powers =>
            simp only [Bool.not_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at bounded powers
            exact ⟨⟨bounded.1.1.1.1, bounded.1.1.1.2, bounded.1.1.2, bounded.1.2, bounded.2⟩,
              by simpa using signature, by simpa using zero, by simpa using uniform,
              powers, accepted⟩

end QleisliKernel.Qpe
